fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address markers visible from the street to help responders identify the property quickly, especially given multiple access points.
• Mark which access point serves as the primary entry to the main residence to reduce confusion when multiple points are visible.
• Clear a designated turnaround area large enough for emergency vehicles, as limited space is currently visible on the property.
• Trim dense vegetation along walkways and access routes to keep pathways clear for responders moving on foot.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can reach and work around it without obstruction.
• Keep gates in fenced sections unlocked or secured with a Knox-style lock so responders can pass through without delay.
• Mark gate locations on fenced sections with reflective indicators so responders can find them quickly under low-visibility conditions.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and detached structure to keep the path between buildings open for responders.
• Post a visible property map or address sign at the primary access point showing the location of the main residence and detached structure.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch the house.
• Thin tree clusters near structures to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of any structure.
• Clear low-hanging branches from scattered trees near the house up to at least 10 feet from the ground.
• Keep vegetation trimmed back from the sides of all driveways and access routes.
• Remove any dead branches or dead plant material from shrubs near structures.
• Separate shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot climb from low plants into tree canopy.
• Maintain the open green space areas by keeping grass mowed short during dry periods.
• Thin scattered trees near structures so there is visible open space between their canopies.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches that could block emergency vehicles.
